title: Canvas Height Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: MicroSim Anatomy
Canvas Height
Iframe Embedding
Width-Responsive Design
description: Interactive p5.js calculator in which learners set a model MicroSim's drawHeight, controlHeight and graphHeight, compute CANVAS_HEIGHT and the iframe height (CANVAS_HEIGHT + 2), and see how many pixels and which controls a too-short iframe hides.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers and learning-technology developers

educational.topic: Canvas height constant and iframe height
learningObjectives: Calculate the canvas height and the iframe height for a MicroSim from its region heights.
Detect when an iframe is too short to show a MicroSim's controls and state how many pixels are hidden.
prerequisites: Draw region and control region of a MicroSim canvas

simulation.modelType: Arithmetic calculator with visual clipping model
equations: hidden pixels = max(0, CANVAS_HEIGHT + 2 - iframe height)

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Worked example followed by predict-then-check practice
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Parameter sliders with a calculator readout
keyQuestions: Where do the numbers 530 and 532 in the H-Bridge MicroSim come from?
What does a reader lose when the iframe is 40 pixels shorter than CANVAS_HEIGHT + 2?
commonMisconceptions: The iframe height equals the drawHeight alone.
The iframe will grow to fit the MicroSim automatically.
The 2 extra pixels can be dropped without consequence.
assessmentOpportunities: Calculate CANVAS_HEIGHT and the iframe height for three new designs before pressing Set iframe correctly.
State how many pixels are hidden for a given canvas and iframe height.
